mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 30 days reduces equity discount rates and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of trading days where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in annualized CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals inflationary pressure forcing monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 thousand units, tight labor market conditions and strong housing demand signal robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1250.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (defined by quarterly GDP growth > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%), a rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized signals overheating and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weakening housing market conditions and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017 base) signals manufacturing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 30 days signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS has risen over the past 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200, simultaneous manufacturing and housing sector contractions signal deepening economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1200.
